scene:
**INT. LIVING ROOM - AFTERNOON**

The ceiling fan CREAKS on speed two. 

NANI (24) walks in holding his bike helmet by the strap, keys jingling in his fingers. He tosses the keys onto the dining table, unbuttoning his collar.

Near the TV unit, SRIDHAR (55) is standing on one foot, holding a roll of brown packing tape between his teeth. 

On the carved wooden corner stand—where an ornamental white Jaipur ceramic vase usually sits—there is now a steel prestige pressure cooker, stripped of its lid. Sticking out of the cooker are three dry plastic sunflowers and a dusty badminton racket.

Nani stops mid-step. He stares at the cooker. Then at Sridhar.

Sridhar doesn’t drop the tape. He uses both hands to adjust the badminton racket by two millimeters, squinting with deep, curatorial satisfaction.

NANI
Nanna.

Sridhar pulls the tape from his mouth, smooths down his vest, and exhales like a man who just completed a grueling surgery.

SRIDHAR
(without looking at him)
Door close cheyyi first-u. AC on cheyale gaani heat wave choodu bayata ela kottukuntundo.

NANI
Cooker akkada enduku undi?

SRIDHAR
(frowning, turning around)
Deniki antha loud ga arusthav? Prathi daaniki immediate ga panic aypovadame. Generation motham concentration span ledhu.

NANI
Arusthale nenu. Normal gaane aduguthunna. Hall lo, showcase pakka... Amma jaipur vase pettina place lo... three-litre induction cooker enduku undi?

SRIDHAR
Weight distribution.

NANI
Enti?

SRIDHAR
(stepping back, gesturing at the stand)
Weight distribution ra. Ee teakwood stand koni padheellu aytundi. Left leg kinda bush arigipoyindi. Notice chesava eppudaina? Ledhu. Phone lo reel-lu scroll cheskodam thappa intlo furniture balance gurinchi pattinchukuntara meeru? Flat surface meeda dead weight lekapothe corner joint expand aypoyi wood crack ichedi.

NANI
Mari cooker lo badminton racket enduku pettav?

SRIDHAR
(beat)
Height adjustment. Aesthetic sense antaru deenini. Neeku thelidu le, interior magazines lo modern rustic look ani untadi. 

Nani drops his helmet on the sofa and walks toward the stand. 

Sridhar instantly shifts his weight, sliding horizontally to block Nani’s view of the corner.

NANI
Pakka ki jarugu okasari.

SRIDHAR
Enduku jaragali? Nenu chusthunna kada.

NANI
Nanna, vase ekkada?

SRIDHAR
Vase gurinchi enduku ippudu neeku? Ninna night nunchi aa vase meeda padipoyav? Neeku inter lo vachina marks gurinchi eppudaina intla investigate chesava? Backlog lu clear cheskune tapudu leni curiosity... kitchen utensils meeda enduku vasthundi ra neeku?

NANI
Ninna night nenu vase gurinchi adagane ledu.

SRIDHAR
Adhe! Appudu adagaledu, ippudu vachi interrogation chesthunnav! Continuity undadhu meetho matladithe.

Nani looks down at the skirting tiles behind Sridhar’s left heel. 

A single white ceramic shard with painted blue floral work is jammed under the baseboard. Sridhar notices Nani looking. He subtly drags his right foot across the floor, trying to sweep the shard under the rug with his toes, but his toe catches the rug edge, flipping it up.

Underneath the rug: a pile of broken white pottery, smashed into roughly forty pieces.

Silence.

The fan CREAKS overhead.

NANI
Idhi kooda rustic interior ah?

Sridhar stares down at the pile. His face doesn’t break. He doesn't even blink.

SRIDHAR
(calmly)
Quality ledu.

NANI
Nanna...

SRIDHAR
Chepthunna kada, quality ledu. Jaipur clay kadhu adi. Nenu appude cheppa me amma ki, road side daggara bargaining chesi konte ilanti duplicate POP material eh istharu. Nenu just dust cloth tho ilaa touch chesa... micro-vibration kooda thalchukoleka spontaneous fracture aypoyindi. Faulty structural integrity.

NANI
Touch chesthe pieces pieces aypoyinda?

SRIDHAR
Physics telusa neeku? Resonance effect. Ameerpet main road meeda aa heavy lorry lu velthunte ground frequency match aypoyi ceramic bonds collapse aytay. Nenu book lo chadivanu.

NANI
Vase meeda hammer marks enduku unnay mari?

Sridhar glares at Nani, deeply offended.

SRIDHAR
Rey! Nenu bank lo cash officer ga retire ayya ra! Oka vastu ni scientifically dissect cheyakunda discard chesthara evaraina? Lopala manufacturing defect ekkada undo identify cheyadaniki nenu test chesa! Neelaga responsibility lekunda thiragadam kadhu!

NANI
Amma ki chepthava mari resonance theory?

Sridhar pauses. The scientific authority drains from his posture for a fraction of a second.

Outside, the SOUND OF AN AUTO RICKSHAW slowing down. 

A distinct, metallic *CLACK* as the auto meter is clicked off.

Sridhar stiffens. He leans slightly toward the window grill, peering out through the curtains. 

His eyes widen.

SRIDHAR
(whispering, urgent)
Rythu bazaar nunchi vachindi. Kothimeera kooda thechindi choodu, mood baledu.

NANI
Nenu cheptha le. Structural integrity valla poyindi ani—

Sridhar lunges forward, grabs Nani’s forearm with surprising, desperate strength, his eyes wide and unblinking.

SRIDHAR
Rey. Nani. Bangaram kadhu? Ninna nuvvu Goa trip gurinchi permission adigav kada?

NANI
Nuvvu straight ga 'kudaradhu' annav.

SRIDHAR
Perspective marchuko ra, life lo prathi daaniki finality undadhu. Discussion open ga undi inka. Five thousand sponsor chestha.

NANI
Amma vase ni chusthe cooker meeda nunchi sunflowers theesi neethone kottisthadi.

SRIDHAR
(rapidly whispering)
Rey, cooker theesi padestha! Ee broken pieces theesko, nee gym bag lo pettu! Bayataki velli ekkadaina gutter lo padesi ra! Nenu lopaliki velli 'donga pilli vachindi' ani cover chestha!

NANI
Grill undi ga window ki? Pilli ela vasthadi?

SRIDHAR
Chinna pilli ra! Gymnastic cat! Nuvvu questions veyaku, bag lo pettu mundhu!

The sound of SLIPPERS slapping against the stairs outside. A key enters the main door lock.

Sridhar instantly lets go of Nani, spins around, crosses his hands behind his back, and faces the pressure cooker with a look of peaceful, intellectual contemplation.

The door SQUEAKS open.
beat_summary: Nani arrives home to find Sridhar has replaced his mother's ornamental Jaipur vase with an open pressure cooker containing plastic sunflowers and a badminton racket.
When Nani questions the setup, Sridhar defensively invents excuses about furniture weight distribution and rustic aesthetics while attempting to block Nani's view.
Sridhar tries to kick a stray ceramic shard under the rug, accidentally flipping the rug up to expose a pile of smashed pottery.
Sridhar doubles down on denial, concocting ridiculous theories about road resonance frequency and testing manufacturing defects with a hammer.
Hearing his wife return home in an auto rickshaw, Sridhar panics, bribes Nani with trip money to smuggle out the broken pieces, and prepares a lie about a gymnastic cat.
As the key turns in the front door, Sridhar resumes a calm, thoughtful pose admiring the cooker.

scene:
**INT. PARENTS' BEDROOM - AFTERNOON**

*SNAP.*

A vicious, rusted safety pin hidden in the leather lining punctures ROHAN’s (17) right thumb cuticle. 

White-hot electric pain shoots straight into his neck. Rohan’s vision tunnels—

FLASH CUT: Rohan at nine years old, getting smacked across the knuckles with a heavy steel dosa turner by his mother for dipping wet fingers into the Bournvita jar. The metallic *THWACK* echoes in his skull.

BACK TO SCENE.

Rohan gags on his own breath, freezing mid-squat beside the dressing table. 

His right wrist is buried three inches deep inside his mother’s maroon faux-leather handbag. He is wearing full neon running shoes, laces double-knotted, already leaning at a forty-five-degree sprint angle toward the balcony door.

Behind him, from the shadows near the godrej almirah, comes the dry, paper-thin RATTLE of an unfolded newspaper.

ANAND (52) is sitting on a low plastic stool, wearing a banyan and a checked lungi tucked up above his knees. He is holding a pair of toenail clippers in one hand and the *Eenadu* city edition in the other. 

He doesn't look up from the obituaries.

ANAND
(monotone)
Zipper chala tight untadi daaniki. Side pocket lo pettadu valla anna US nunchi techina lock. Force cheyaku, tear aypothadi.

Rohan’s neck turns stiffly, like a rusty hinge. 

ROHAN
Nanna.

ANAND
Hmm.

ROHAN
Nuvvu... paper hall lo chaduvuthav kada roju?

ANAND
(clipping a nail with a sharp SNAP)
Fan hall lo sound chesthundi. Illu motham disturbance. Nuvvu cheyalsina pani kaniyyi mundhu. Distract cheyadam enduku nannu?

Rohan tries to smoothly pull his hand out. 

The zipper teeth bite hard into his knuckles. Three loose safety pins and a string of plastic bindi cards are tangled around his Casio watch strap. Deep inside his closed fist, crumpled into a sweaty ball, is a bright pink ₹500 note.

ROHAN
Nenu em cheyatle.

ANAND
(turning the page calmly)
Aithe aa handbag tho handshake chesthunnava?

ROHAN
Handbag kadhu idi. Sanitization issue.

ANAND
Sanitization issue ah?

ROHAN
Ninna night dining table meeda Amma ee bag petti kothimeera katta pettindi. Cross-contamination idea unda neeku? Ee artificial leather pores lo Salmonella bacteria three weeks live untadi. Nenu biology teacher tho discuss chesa. Amma hand sanitizer bottle pettindo ledo cross-check chesthunna.

ANAND
Sanitizer vethukuthu dressing table meeda shoe-lu vesukuni nilchuntara?

ROHAN
(instantly defensive)
Orthopedic shoes ivi! Flat-foot alignment problem undi naku. Barefoot ga mosaic tiles meeda nadisthe lower spine meeda kinetic shock vasthadi. Doctor chepparu. Neeku prathi daantlo thappe kanipisthadi. Family health gurinchi evaranna care theesukunte appreciation undadhu asalu ee intlo!

ANAND
(slowly puts down the clippers)
Appreciation aa? 

ROHAN
Avunu! Roju nenu okkadine micro-hygiene gurinchi alochisthunna. Amma emo bus stop lanti places lo currency exchange chesthadi, malli adhe chetitho kitchen lo rotilu chesthadi.

ANAND
Sare. Bag vadiley mari. Bacteria theesukuni washbasin lo soap tho kadugu po.

Rohan’s arm remains locked inside the bag. He tries to subtly uncurl his fingers to drop the note back, but the currency gets stuck on the velcro pocket flap. 

ROHAN
Aaguko okka nimisham. String lock ayyindi.

ANAND
Lock avvaledu Rohan. Gammuna theeyi bayataki.

ROHAN
Technical ga chepthunna kada, handle stitch lo nail irukkupoyindi. Nee over-anxiety valla tension create avthundi ikkada.

Anand gets up from the stool. He doesn’t rush. He adjusts his lungi, walks over with heavy, flat footsteps, and stands two feet behind Rohan.

He looks down into the open maw of the purse.

ANAND
Nee chethilo pink color paper scrap enti?

ROHAN
(eyes shifting rapidly)
Paper scrap kadhu. Amma ki warn cheyadaniki nenu hold chesa.

ANAND
Hold chesava?

ROHAN
Market lo fake currency syndicate thiruguthundi Nanna. Gachibowli signal daggara petrol bunk lo duplicate five hundred notes distribute chesthunnaru. Texture choodu ela undo... visual inspection lo thelipothundi idhi RBI paper eh kadhu! Nenu safe custody lo theesukuni, sunlight lo watermark verification cheddam ani balcony ki velthunna!

ANAND
Watermark verification ki running shoes tho ready ga sprint posture pettava?

ROHAN
Sprint posture kadhu! Calisthenic balance antaru deenini!

ANAND
(pointing at the note)
Nee chethilo unna note meeda corner lo choodu. Blue ink tho ‘Geetha milk shop 420’ ani rasindi. Ninna nenu ATM nunchi thechi icchina fresh note adi.

Silence hits the room. 

The pedestal fan in the corner OSCILLATES with a dry, rhythmic clatter. 

Rohan swallows hard, his grip tightening around the note out of pure reflex.

ROHAN
(clearing his throat)
Aithe... ATM machine lone ink smudges unnay Nanna. Banking sector lo standard operational standards chala padipoyayi. Nuvvu complain register cheyali SBI lo.

ANAND
(deadpan)
Nenu SBI ki veltha gaani... nuvvu mundhu me Amma ki explain cheyyi.

Anand steps sideways by one foot, clearing Rohan’s line of sight to the attached bathroom.

The bathroom door creaks wide open.

AMMA stands in the doorway in an old cotton saree, her face completely covered in a thick, wet layer of dark green ayurvedic multani-m मिट्टी, eyes burning through two dry eyeholes. In her right hand, dripping wet, is a wooden rolling pin she had taken inside to scrape off bathroom scale.

Rohan’s stomach drops through the floorboards. 

He instantly yanks his arm with all his strength. 

The handbag rips free from the zipper, catapulting a cloud of loose safety pins, used bus tickets, and a silver coin across the mosaic floor. Rohan freezes, chest heaving, his fist clamped shut in the air, standing at total attention like an NCC cadet.

ROHAN
(voice cracking, dead-faced)
Amma... Ameerpet metro shockwaves valla drawer open aypoyi bag kindha padipoyindi. Nenu just catch chesa.

Amma slowly raises the rolling pin. 

Rohan drops into a defensive crouch without moving a single muscle in his face.
beat_summary: Rohan punctures his thumb on a hidden safety pin while attempting to steal a 500-rupee note from his mother's purse, flashing back to past discipline.
Rohan discovers his father, Anand, calmly sitting nearby clipping his toenails and watching him in silence.
Caught red-handed with his wrist tangled in the bag, Rohan invents frantic excuses about hygiene, Salmonella contamination, and orthopedic shoe postures.
Anand confronts Rohan about the pink note balled in his fist, prompting Rohan to fabricate a story about counterfeit currency inspection.
Anand dismantles the lie by identifying his own handwriting on the note, then steps aside to reveal Rohan's mother holding a rolling pin in the bathroom doorway.
Rohan violently tears his arm free, scattering the purse contents, delivers one last desperate excuse, and drops into a rigid defensive crouch.
